name: Outer Orbit Drift
core_rationale: Northernmost zero-gravity comet-shard drift of Aphelion Halo Rim at [1, 0] where Vesper's outermost starlight chains trail off into the uncharted astral sea.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Cartographers claim the last buoy in Outer Orbit Drift is tied not to an island, but to the prow of a sleeping star-galleon.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A slow-spinning ribbon of frost-coated comet boulders trailing silver dust into the northern aurora.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Who crewed the sleeping star-galleon moored beyond the Outer Orbit Drift?

causal_continuity.evidence: Marks the outermost orbital boundary of scar-vesper-crater in Aphelion Halo Rim.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Frost-coated comet boulders trailing silver dust toward a sleeping star-galleon.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: terrain tile and prop kit metrics for 1.05m characters will be bound when promoted to Canon.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: gated behind the North fog_of_lore portal on town-aphelion-buoy-haven.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null and complete mystery_hook without generating filler map geometry.
